sections.content: You know reported statements from B1 Unit 13 and reported questions from A2 Unit 14. Here you put them together to retell a whole exchange, with a statement and a question in one account, from your own point of view.

items.spanish: El testigo explicó que había visto al hombre.
items.english: The witness explained that he had seen the man.

items.spanish: También preguntó si alguien había llamado a la policía.
items.english: He also asked if anyone had called the police.

items.spanish: El detective explicó que los testigos no recordaban lo mismo, así que necesitaba más información.
items.english: The detective explained that the witnesses did not remember the same thing, so he needed more information.

sections.content: In one account, keep every verb on the same shifted timeline: if the first verb is *había visto*, the rest follows it, as in *El testigo explicó que había visto al hombre y preguntó si alguien había llamado*.
